title: citrus × aurantium subf. medioglobosa
intro: Citrus × aurantium subf. medioglobosa, commonly known as bitter orange peel, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family known for its unique properties. Bitter orange peel is valued for its potential health benefits, including aiding in weight loss, improving digestion, and reducing inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, alleviate nausea, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Citrus × aurantium subf. medioglobosa include flavonoids, limonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
